title: Protest Funding
intro: The death of George Floyd, the unrest that followed, the bail funds, and the official response, taken from primary records: medical-examiner and court records, government orders and reviews, filings, and people's own words. Where a source is research data, industry data, a party's legal brief or a partisan legislative report, the page says so.

charts.title: Protest Funding: Records by Section
charts.note: Tap a bar or key line to open that section.

sections.title: 3. Bail funds
notes: Specific people released on MFF-paid bail and later charged with new offenses have been reported by news outlets. They are not included here because the underlying court records were not independently retrieved for this draft (see the open-questions list).

protest-funding-1.title: The Minnesota Freedom Fund's 2020 IRS Form 990 (EIN 82-1214607), posted on the organization's own website, reports $41,655,560 in…
lines: The Minnesota Freedom Fund's 2020 IRS Form 990 (EIN 82-1214607), posted on the organization's own website, reports $41,655,560 in contributions and $41,667,782 in total revenue for 2020. (MFF 2020 Form 990)

protest-funding-2.title: The same filing reports total expenses of $7,336,398, so revenue exceeded expenses by $34,331,384.

protest-funding-3.title: The Form 990 describes the fund's program as having posted "APPROXIMATELY $10,000,000 IN CRIMINAL BAIL" for "APPROXIMATELY 610…
lines: The Form 990 describes the fund's program as having posted "APPROXIMATELY $10,000,000 IN CRIMINAL BAIL" for "APPROXIMATELY 610 MINNESOTANS." (MFF 2020 Form 990)

protest-funding-4.title: It also reports approximately $2,070,000 in immigration bonds for about 150 people, and a $4,500,000 grant to the National Bail Fund Network.

protest-funding-5.title: The filing does not break out how much bail went to people arrested in connection with the 2020 protests or riots.

protest-funding-6.title: On June 1, 2020, Kamala Harris posted
lines: "If you're able to, chip in now to the @MNFreedomFund to help post bail for those protesting on the ground in Minnesota." The post included a donation link. (Post by @KamalaHarris; archived copy)

protest-funding-7.title: The post asks others to donate.
lines: It does not state whether Harris herself donated. (Post by @KamalaHarris)
